function: Channel estimation under phase noise: a DL estimator maps PN-impaired pilots at each AP to channel estimates, initializing the centralized channel and CPE estimator (p. 6, p. 8).
system: Uplink cell-free massive MIMO OFDM: 5 to 200 single-antenna APs combined at a CPU, K single-antenna UEs, 2 GHz, 10 MHz; no RIS (p. 2-3, p. 9).
method: Supervised: fully connected NN (three dense layers, 100 neurons, residual connection), MSE loss on 3000 channel realizations; initializes the alternating LMMSE channel and CPE estimator (p. 6, p. 9).
data_channel: Simulated block-fading channels, model 'Spatially correlated [4]', APs uniform in 1x1 km2 or on a radio stripe, Wiener-process phase noise; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 3, p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained on 3000 realizations of one distribution; retraining needed if it changes (p. 6); AP count and UE power swept, retraining not stated (p. 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned: PN-unaware MMSE, mismatched PN-aware LMMSE, single-carrier LMMSE, own distributed LMMSE; learned: none, only the proposed DL estimator versus LMMSE initialization (p. 9).
metrics: Uplink achievable spectral efficiency per UE with MMSE combining, MSE of normalized channel estimate, CPE estimation MSE (p. 9-12).
complexity: Table I: complex multiplications per coherence block for every estimator; DL estimator costs (2*tau_p*M1 + M1*M2 + 2*M2*K)/4 per serving AP; Table II: fronthaul overhead (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 9: Table IV lists the channel model as "Spatially correlated [4]"; p. 3: "βk,l is the large-scale fading coefficient" of a block-fading model. Custom simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel is named.
q2_support: p. 6: "We train the DL estimators on a diverse set of channel realizations sampled from a specific distribution" and "Re-training is required if the channel distribution changes." The sweeps of AP count and UE power (p. 11-12) do not state reuse without retraining.
q3_support: p. 9: baselines "Unaware (Distr.)", "Mismatched (Distr.)" and "Single-carrier (Distr.)" are non-learned MMSE or LMMSE estimators. No earlier learned estimator or other NN is compared; the DL estimator is only compared with its LMMSE-initialized variant.
q4_support: p. 7: Table I "Computational complexity per coherence block for different channel and PN estimators", with a DL estimator row; p. 14: "real-valued multiplications to generate channel predictions for all K UEs".
q5_support: p. 9: Tables III and IV define a custom simulation (3000 training realizations, 100 Monte Carlo runs); the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset (the text ends at p. 16 with appendices and references).
notes: Included because a learned component (fully connected DL channel estimator, p. 6) performs channel estimation inside the proposed pipeline, although the main estimators are LMMSE; area 2. Check 6 judgement: APs and UEs have single antennas (p. 9), but 5 to 200 APs combine at a CPU as distributed massive MIMO (p. 3, footnote 2); reviewer to confirm. PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (2410.18722v2, 25 Jun 2025); the DOI is not printed in the file, so identity rests on the title.
